question: Does a basis fitted to the full causal H3 response object, rather than scalar/complement loss, recover the functionally missing rank-two branch on sealed v8?

frozen_design.fit_object: Stack every actual L8H1-induced block11 H3 output delta at every causal position from v1/v2 A1/A2, without labels, logits, v8 rows, or parameter updates. Use the leading four right singular vectors of this uncentered response matrix.
frozen_design.matched_baseline: Replay the previously frozen two-task DIM-union rank-two basis in the same v8 instrument.
frozen_design.outcomes: Signed answer/foil recovery and joint L15H5/H1 response norms on the 29/31 capable v8 rows.

predictions.pred_a_authority_seal_exact_instrument_a: All authorities, no-v8-fit seal, orthonormality, attention reconstruction, identity/projection closure, complete records, and price hold.
predictions.pred_b_rank4_captures_training_response_: Rank four captures at least 85% of v1/v2 causal-response Frobenius energy; this is a fit control, not circuit evidence.
predictions.pred_c_rank4_is_fresh_behaviorally_suffi: On both v8 panels rank four retains at least 90% of full-H3 behavior and improves over frozen rank two by at least 10 percentage points.
predictions.pred_d_rank4_orthogonal_complement_is_se: Absolute orthogonal-complement behavior is at most 15% of full H3 in both panels.
predictions.pred_e_rank4_restores_downstream_transpo: Rank four retains at least 85% of full H3-induced L15H5/H1 response and improves over frozen rank two by at least 10 points in both panels.

decision: identification if all pass; insufficient_rank if A/B hold but C/D/E fail; wrong_object if B fails or rank four does not beat rank two; null if full H3 loses materiality; invalid if A fails.
